function.name: click
function.description: Performs a mouse click at specific screen coordinates.

x.description: The absolute horizontal pixel coordinate relative to the viewport's top-left corner.

y.description: The absolute vertical pixel coordinate relative to the viewport's top-left corner.

clicks.description: The number of consecutive clicks to perform (e.g., 1 for a single click, 2 for a double click).

function.name: write
function.description: Type text using the keyboard. This will first clear any existing content in the focused input field (using Ctrl+A and Backspace), then type the new text. Make sure to click on an input field before using this action.

message.description: The text content to type into the focused input field

function.name: press_keys
function.description: Press specific keys or key combinations on the keyboard. Use this for navigation, shortcuts, or discrete key presses.

keys.description:
The list of specific keys to press. 
ACCEPTED KEYS:
- Modifiers: "Alt", "Control", "Meta", "Shift"
- Actions: "Enter", "Tab", "Space", "Backspace", "Delete", "Escape"
- Navigation: "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Home", "End", "PageUp", "PageDown"
- Standard: "a"-"z", "0"-"9", "F1"-"F12"

is_hotkey.description: If true, all keys in the list are pressed simultaneously (e.g., ["Control", "c"]). If false, keys are pressed one by one in sequence.

presses.description: Number of times to repeat the press action.

function.name: scroll
function.description: Scroll the page vertically in the specified direction. Use this to view content that is not currently visible on the screen.

amount.description: Scroll amount as a percentage of the viewport height (0.0 to 1.0). For example, 0.5 means scroll by half a page.

function.name: wait
function.description: Wait for a specified number of seconds before continuing. Use this when you need to allow time for page content to load or for animations to complete.

seconds.description: Number of seconds to wait (integer value)

function.name: done
function.description: Signal task completion and provide the final answer. Call this function when you have successfully completed the task, or when you have determined that the task cannot be completed. Provide a clear and concise response summarizing what was accomplished or explaining why the task could not be completed.

response.description: The final answer, result, or summary of the task. Be specific and include relevant details such as: the information found, actions completed, or reason for task failure.

function.name: go_back
function.description: Navigate back to the previous page in the browser history. Equivalent to clicking the browser's back button.

function.name: drag_mouse
function.description: Perform a drag-and-drop operation from a starting screen coordinate to an ending coordinate.

from_x.description: The absolute X coordinate to start dragging from.

from_y.description: The absolute Y coordinate to start dragging from.

to_x.description: The absolute X coordinate to drop at.

to_y.description: The absolute Y coordinate to drop at.

steps.description: The number of intermediate mouse steps to take. Higher values make the drag slower and more human-like. Use 10-20 for standard drags.

function.name: hover
function.description: Move the mouse cursor to a specific coordinate. Use this to trigger hover states, reveal tooltips, or open dropdown menus.

x.description: The absolute X coordinate (pixels from the left) to move the cursor to.

y.description: The absolute Y coordinate (pixels from the top) to move the cursor to.

function.name: call_user
function.description:
Stop execution and ask the human user for input. Use this tool ONLY in these specific situations:
1. AMBIGUITY: The task instructions are vague (e.g., 'buy the shoes' but no color is specified).
2. SAFETY: You are about to perform a high-stakes action (e.g., deleting data, sending emails, completing a purchase).
3. UNBLOCKING: You are stuck (e.g., a CAPTCHA appears, or a page fails to load).

question.description: The specific question to ask the user. Be concise and provide context on why you are asking.
